districtFact: Deer Valley Unified publishes PreK–12 instructional calendar PDFs with a 180-day student calendar, 185 teacher contract days, Friday 90-minute early releases, parent-teacher conference half days, semester half days, staff development days, school breaks, holidays, graduation notes, and semester day counts.

about.title: About Deer Valley Unified School District
about.content: Deer Valley Unified School District serves families in the North Phoenix area of Maricopa County. Its instructional calendar is especially important for family planning because the district uses selected Friday 90-minute early releases, grade-band half days, parent-teacher conference half days, and staff development days when students do not attend.

about.title: District Calendar and Campus Schedules
about.content: This page summarizes districtwide DVUSD dates. Families should still check their school for bell schedules, bus routes, testing, athletics, performances, graduation ceremony details, and campus-specific updates.

planningTips.title: DVUSD Calendar Notes
content: DVUSD lists 90-minute early-release dates separately from half-day release dates.
Parent-teacher conference half days may apply to different grade bands depending on the month.
The district calendar marks half days for grades 9–12 only and grades K–12 separately near the end of first semester.
Graduation dates and ceremony details may be updated outside the instructional calendar PDF.

districtFaqs.q: Does DVUSD use regular early-release days?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The reviewed DVUSD instructional calendars list selected Friday early-release days, usually 90 minutes early, along with separate half-day release dates.

districtFaqs.q: Are DVUSD staff development days student attendance days?
districtFaqs.a: No. Staff development days shown as no-school dates are not student attendance days.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify DVUSD calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official DVUSD calendar page and school announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Deer Valley Unified School District.
